name: TravelKit Trip Comparison for WP Travel Engine
author: WP Travel Kit

sections.description:
TravelKit Trip Comparison for WP Travel Engine lets travellers compare your WP Travel Engine trips side by side, decide with confidence, and book — no coding required.

Help travellers choose faster, and book more of the traffic you already have.

Most travellers don’t hesitate because your trips aren’t good — they hesitate because they can’t tell them apart. TravelKit Trip Comparison lets visitors line up your WP Travel Engine trips side by side, see exactly how they differ, and pick the one that fits. Fewer open tabs, fewer abandoned carts, more bookings.

The plugin adds a lightweight “Compare” button to your trip cards, a sticky tray that follows visitors as they browse, and a clean side-by-side view — a full comparison table on desktop and swipeable cards on mobile. It reads your real WP Travel Engine data automatically, so there’s nothing to duplicate or maintain by hand.

Upgrade to Trip Comparison Pro | View Trip Comparison Demo

Why travel businesses use TravelKit Trip Comparison

https://wptravelkit.com/wordpress-travel-plugins/trip-comparison/

  • Turn indecisive browsers into confident bookers with a clear side-by-side view
  • Put a “Request Quote” call-to-action exactly where the decision happens
  • Keep visitors on your site instead of comparing you in ten browser tabs
  • Match it to your brand and place the compare button wherever it converts best

Compare experience

  • Compare chip on trip cards — Add or remove trips from archives and single trip pages
  • Flexible chip placement — Bottom of card, top, image overlay, beside your CTA, or single-trip only
  • Sticky compare tray — Floating bar with trip thumbnails, a live count, Clear, and “Compare now”
  • Tray position — Bottom-right, centered, or bottom-left
  • Side-by-side comparison — Desktop table with images, titles, and View links
  • Mobile comparison cards — Swipeable cards with navigation dots
  • Configurable comparison limit — Choose how many trips visitors can compare at once (2–12; default 3)
  • Selection memory — Remembers a visitor’s picks while they browse

Comparison content

  • Core fields — Price, Duration, Destination, and Difficulty (enable, reorder, relabel)
  • Sale-aware pricing — Pulls regular, sale, and display price from WP Travel Engine
  • Difficulty indicators — Visual easy/moderate/hard chips
  • Footer CTA + disclaimer — Optional “Request Quote” link and a disclaimer under the table

Branding & embed

  • Brand colours — Set your accent plus tray background and text
  • [tktrip] shortcode — Embed a comparison anywhere (optional trip IDs)
  • Gutenberg block — Drop a comparison block into any page or post

Requirements

TravelKit Trip Comparison works best with WP Travel Engine. Without it installed, comparison rows stay empty.

External services

This plugin makes no external API calls. All scripts, styles, and fonts are bundled with the plugin — nothing is loaded from a CDN, and no data is sent anywhere.

The WP Travel Kit admin screens include optional documentation, tutorial, and support links to wptravelkit.com, and a link to the WP Travel Kit Facebook group. These are ordinary links that an administrator can choose to click. Nothing is requested or sent unless a link is opened.

  • wptravelkit.com — terms of service, privacy policy
  • facebook.com — terms of service, privacy policy

Privacy

TravelKit Trip Comparison stores anonymous comparison events in your WordPress database (event type, trip IDs, and a coarse device class: mobile/desktop). No names, emails, IP addresses, or cookies are stored with these events, and nothing is sent to WP Travel Kit or any other third party.

Rate limiting stores a short-lived hash of the visitor’s IP address in a transient. It is never written to the events table and expires automatically.

Events older than 24 months are deleted automatically. Uninstalling the plugin drops the events table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the travelkit-trip-comparison folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WP Travel Engine is installed and active.
  4. Go to WP Travel Kit → TravelKit Trip Comparison to choose where the compare chip appears, pick your fields, and set your brand colours.
  5. Visit any trip archive to see the compare chip and sticky tray in action.
sections.faq:
Do I need WP Travel Engine to use TravelKit Trip Comparison?

Yes. The plugin reads trips, prices, durations, destinations, and difficulty from WP Travel Engine. Without it, the compare buttons have nothing to attach to, so install WP Travel Engine first. An admin notice appears if it is missing.

How many trips can visitors compare at once?

Set any number between 2 and 12 under WP Travel Kit → TravelKit Trip Comparison → Settings. The default is 3.

How does comparing trips help me get more bookings?

Indecision is where bookings die. When a traveller sees two or three of your trips side by side, the right choice becomes obvious — and the optional “Request Quote” CTA sits right under the comparison, so ready-to-book visitors reach out instead of leaving.

Can I match it to my brand?

Yes. Set your accent and tray colours, relabel and reorder fields, and choose where the compare chip appears. Embed a comparison anywhere with the [tktrip] shortcode or the Gutenberg block.

Will it slow down my site?

No. TravelKit Trip Comparison is lightweight and performance-optimised, so your trip pages keep loading fast.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

Fixed Tab isssues and updated core.

1.0.2

Renamed to TravelKit Trip Comparison

1.0.1

  • First public release.
  • Compare chip on WP Travel Engine trip cards, with five placement options.
  • Sticky compare tray with trip thumbnails, a live count, and Clear.
  • Side-by-side comparison table on desktop; swipeable comparison cards on mobile.
  • Core comparison fields — price (sale-aware), duration, destination, and difficulty — each of which can be enabled, reordered, and relabelled.
  • Configurable comparison limit, from 2 to 12 trips.
  • Brand accent and tray colours, optional footer CTA and disclaimer.
  • [tktrip] shortcode and a Gutenberg block for embedding a comparison anywhere.
  • Anonymous comparison analytics with a 24-month retention policy.
